title: Datadog
summary: Datadog MCP server (preview). OAuth; non-US1 sites replace the host (e.g. mcp.datadoghq.eu). Covers backend telemetry (APM/logs/metrics) and frontend RUM/browser.
rationale: Observability access for runnable services, pipelines, and frontend apps — backend (APM/logs/metrics) and client-side (RUM/browser) telemetry alike
